title: Code of practice for laying of bitumen mastic flooring for industries handling LPG and other light hydrocarbon products
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard lays down the procedure for laying bitumen mastic flooring for industries handling LPG and other light hydrocarbon products.

clause_2_normative_references.title: bitumen mastic for flooring for industries handling LPG and other light hydrocarbon products

clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for laying of bitumen mastic flooring for industries handling LPG and other light hydrocarbon products

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
